## SignedDownload interface

Remote read result: a short-lived signed HTTP URL that delivers the content.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SignedDownload
```

## Remarks

The URL is a bearer capability for this one transfer, valid until `expiresAt`<!-- -->. A fresh `fetch()` issues a fresh URL. It is never logged.
